summary: Three bedroom upper flat · Great Sandyford location · No HMO in place · Available now
description:
A light & airy three bedroom flat in an excellent Sandyford location.

My Property Box welcome to the Lettings market this delightful three bedroom flat on Greystoke Avenue, Sandyford.

Situated mid-terrace, the first floor flat comprises; entrance hallway with stairs to first floor landing, large front double bedroom, second double bedroom, third 'spare room', central living room following through to galley kitchen, family bathroom & private rear yard.

The well presented property makes for an ideal home for a family, couple or two sharers who desire plenty of space and natural light as well as a great Sandyford location. Please note this property does not have an HMO license so is not available to three sharers. Available now, furnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
